headline: Gulf Petrocas Signs Deal to Build 100 Retail Gas Stations in Uzbekistan
summary: Tashkent municipal authorities signed a memorandum of understanding with Gulf Petrocas Energy Group to establish a network of up to 100 Gulf-branded retail fuel stations in Uzbekistan.
why: Gulf Petrocas is an international downstream petroleum refining and distribution group expanding footprint across Central Asia.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: A 100-station filling network expands foreign direct investment in Uzbek downstream fuel distribution.
